items.heading: 1. Information We Collect
items.text: When you request a free trial, contact us, or register for an account, we collect information such as the student's name and age, a parent or guardian's name, country, WhatsApp/phone number, email address, and preferred class schedule. Once enrolled, we also record attendance, lesson notes, homework, progress, and payment history in connection with the classes provided.

items.heading: 2. How We Use Information
items.text: We use this information to respond to inquiries, schedule and deliver classes, match students with suitable teachers, communicate about classes and account activity, process payments, and improve our services. We do not sell personal information to third parties.

items.heading: 3. Children's Information
items.text: Many of our students are children. Accounts and profiles for children are created and managed by a parent or guardian, who consents to the collection described in this policy on the child's behalf. We only collect information about a child that is necessary to provide our educational services.

items.heading: 4. Communication Channels
items.text: We may contact you by email, WhatsApp, phone, or in-app messaging regarding trial requests, class scheduling, homework, payments, and general announcements.

items.heading: 5. Data Security
items.text: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, or loss, including encrypted transmission and access controls limiting staff access to what is needed for their role.

items.heading: 6. Your Rights
items.text: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, or that of a child in your care, by contacting us using the details on our Contact page.

items.heading: 7. Changes to This Policy
items.text: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

items.heading: 1. Our Services
items.text: Hafiz Quran Tutor provides one-to-one online Quran and Islamic Studies classes, including a free trial class, ongoing enrollment, scheduling, and progress tracking, delivered by teachers engaged by us.

items.heading: 2. Free Trial
items.text: The free trial class is offered at our discretion, subject to teacher availability, and does not obligate you to enroll further. Trial requests are reviewed and confirmed by our team before a class is scheduled.

items.heading: 3. Enrollment & Scheduling
items.text: Enrollment begins once an admission is confirmed and a package is agreed. Classes are scheduled in the student's selected time zone; rescheduling or cancellation of a specific class is handled according to our scheduling policy communicated at enrollment.

items.heading: 4. Payments
items.text: Package pricing, billing period, and payment method will be confirmed with you before enrollment. Invoices are issued per billing period; continued access to scheduled classes is subject to payments being kept current.

items.heading: 5. Conduct
items.text: Students, parents, and teachers are expected to communicate respectfully. We reserve the right to suspend or end an enrollment in cases of abusive conduct, non-payment, or violation of these terms.

items.heading: 6. Intellectual Property
items.text: Course materials, curriculum, and website content are the property of Hafiz Quran Tutor or its licensors and may not be reproduced or redistributed without permission.

items.heading: 7. Changes to These Terms
items.text: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of our services after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
